packages/contracts/src/orchestrationV2.t.reason: The only ++ contract data dual-written next to the typed plusplus sidecar carrier are the four released legacy seam groups: SEAM-185 contextBridge on ServerSettings and its patch, SEAM-181 startedAt on PendingBackgroundTask, SEAM-182 monetaryUsage on ServerProviderUsageLimits, and SEAM-183 usageAccounts on ServerProvider. Released clients and stored payloads read those fields directly, so writers keep emitting them while sidecar-first reads prefer the typed carrier. All future ++ data must be sidecar-only; no new direct ++ fields may be added to upstream structs.
